IMPORTANT NOTICE
Empty heading
EFFECTIVE JANUARY 2024
OUR NEW REMIT ADDRESS FOR REAL ESTATE TAX PAYMENTS IS:
P.O. BOX 347
BATAVIA, OHIO 45103
*IF YOU HAVE YOUR PAYMENT SET UP WITH ONLINE BILL PAY THROUGH YOUR BANK, PLEASE UPDATE THE ADDRESS.
*IF YOU DO NOT UPDATE, YOUR PAYMENT COULD BE RETURNED TO YOU.
You can no longer pay your real estate taxes at the local banks. Please mail your payment in the envelope provided with your bill before the due date or pay your taxes at the Treasurer’s office, online through Treasurer’s website or through your bank’s online services.
REAL ESTATE TAX
Real Estate Taxes are now certified for Tax Year 2025 and are available for viewing by clicking the Real Estate Search link.
First Half Real Estate Taxes are Due February 13, 2026.
Second Half Real Estate Due Date is August 7, 2026.
Payments received after that date will be assessed a statutory late payment penalty of 5% for the first 10 days after the due date. The full 10% penalty will be assessed thereafter.
MANUFACTURED HOMES
Manufactured Home Taxes to be certified for Tax Year 2026 and will be available for viewing by clicking the Real Estate Search link.
First Half Manufactured Home Due Date is March 2, 2026.
Second Half Manufactured Home Due Date is August 31, 2026.
Payments received after that date will be assessed a statutory late payment penalty of 5% for the first 10 days after the due date. The full 10% penalty will be assessed thereafter.
